characters.name: Brandy Harrington
characters.description: A selfish, arrogant, fashion-obsessed teenage female dog who is forced to live with the annoying Mr. Whiskers. Always Introduces Themselves: More often than not, especially when she's interested in someone, she'll introduce herself, with much panache, as "Brandy Harrington, of the Florida Harringtons!" Badass Adorable: Best demonstrated when she fights as a Masked Luchador. She's pretty good at wrestling and manhandling larger enemies, having done so since she was a pup against her litter of siblings. Bare Midriffs Are Feminine: She is a fashion-obsessed teenager who wears a pink blouse that shows her midriff. Big Sister Bully: Often goes out of her way to put Mr. Whiskers through Hell for the fun of it.

characters.name: Mr. Whiskers
characters.description: An annoying, foolish but happy-go-lucky rabbit who is forced to live with the spoiled Brandy afteraccidentally kickstarting the plot of the show. All of the Other Reindeer: Since he's so disgusting and obnoxious, most animals avoid him like the plague. This is especially shown in "The No Sleep Over". Big Eater: Once ate his way through a pile of oystersas big as himself. Butt-Monkey: Suffers a lot of slapstick, is constantly made fun of and occasionally beat up by the other animals, and even thecutaway gagslike to make fun of him. Camp Straight: He's very flamboyant and theatrical but has shown attraction to women, particularly butch and masculine ones.

characters.name: Ed
characters.description: All of the Other Reindeer: "The No Sleep Over" shows he's an outcast in the rainforest. This may be the reason why he is best friends with fellow outcast Whiskers. Cloud Cuckoolander: Only when he's telling stories, in which he tends to stretch the truth. Deadpan Snarker: He has a rather dry sense of humor.Mr.Whiskers:Oh Ed, you're a genius!Ed:Thanks, Whiskers. And you're.....ummmmmm, I'm gonna have to get back to you on that.And of course, this scene from the birthday episode:Brandy:Okay, is it possible to work even slower?Ed:You know, I haven't given it that much thought but I reckon it just might be possible.Brandy:I was totally being sarcastic.Ed:Oh! Well, it shames me to admit it, Miss Brandy, but I don't traffic in sarcasm too much, so I don't really tend to recognize it when it is out there. You could give me a heads up, like, "Hey, sarcastic comment coming." Just let me know and then I'll--I'll have my eyes open. I mean, come on, a sarcastic otter? That'll be unnatural. And of course, this scene from the birthday episode: Jive Turkey: In Loathe Triangle, he makes fun of this trope.

characters.name: Lola Boa
characters.description: Only Sane Woman: The most level-headed character in the show. Snakes Are Sinister:Thoroughly Averted.She is one of the friendlier and more helpful characters in the show. Species Surname: Her last name being "Boa".

characters.name: Cheryl and Meryl
characters.description: Always Identical Twins: Cheryl and Meryl are identical twin toucans. Non-Mammal Mammaries: Played with, their very prominent chest feathers make them look well-endowed. Vitriolic Best Buds: The two's constant fighting is aRunning Gag.

characters.name: Gaspar le Gecko
characters.description: Abhorrent Admirer: He is this to Brandy, making it even worse given that he is married and that Brandy is implied to be a teenager, while Gaspar himself is most likely an adult. Authority in Name Only: Claims to be ruler of the jungle, but other than a bunch of thuggish monkeys who enforce his demands no one really takes him seriously most of the time.Brandy herself brings this up in a few episodes,which really frustrates Gaspar (especially since he can't refute her). Big Bad: The closest thing to a major villain the show has. Depending on the Writer: Althought his personality stays the same, how evil Gaspar overall is varies. Sometimes he is a murderous tyrant, other times he is a selfish con man, and other times he is just a petty jerk. Everything's Sexier in French: Subverted. Not only does everyone find him annoying, but Brandy even says in one episode that he sounds better without the accent.

characters.name: Margo
characters.description: Advertised Extra: Appeared in advertising and even had her own character page on the website, but barely ever appeared in the show proper. Alpha Bitch: More so than Brandy. She is very selfish, snobby, vain, and pretentious and thrives on belittling others to make herself feel better, especially Brandy. Characterization Marches On: In season 1, she was aDeadpan Snarkerwho had anicer sideand hung out with Brandy' friend group. In season 2, she becomes a stereotypicalAlpha BitchandThe Rivalto Brandy. Deadpan Snarker: Most of her dialogue is being as snarky as possible to everyone around her. Informed Species: Despite being a stick insect she looks more like a praying mantis thanks to the shape of her head and green skin.

characters.name: Tiffany Turlington
characters.description: Alliterative Name: Her initials would be "TT". Alpha Bitch: Even more so than Brandy, even willing to leave Whiskers to his death to leave the jungle. Bare Midriffs Are Feminine: She's aValley Girl, and like Brandy, her blue shirt goes just above her navel. Jerkass: Would rather save herself than help out Mr. Whiskers and looks down on Brandy for having slightly less money than she does. Suspiciously Similar Substitute: Played with. She's basically Brandy but meaner and brattier, essentially being a version of Brandy without any redeeming qualities.

characters.name: Sandy Carington
characters.description: The Ace: She's excels at everything she does and is beloved by all the jungle. Always Someone Better: To Brandy. Foil: From what we can see, she's more patient and nicer to Mr. Frisky than Brandy is to Mr. Whiskers, as she doesn't blame Frisky for somehow mistaking a hatch for a light switch. Nice Girl: More so than Brandy is, as her debut appearance would show.

characters.name: Mr. Frisky
characters.description: The Ace: Just like Sandy, he's really good at everything he does, especially compared to Whiskers. Always Someone Better: For Whiskers. Hyper-Competent Sidekick: Although he caused himself and Sandy to end up in the jungle the same way Whiskers did, he is far more competent than Whiskers and is on par with Sandy. Nice Guy: He's all in all good person at heart and essentially has all the good qualities that Mr. Whiskers happens to lack.
